GROK 4.5 RANKS #1 FOR REAL-WORLD CODING QUALITY AND POLISH

In a direct head-to-head test where Grok 4.5, Fable 5, and GPT 5.5 were given the exact same prompt to build a game, Grok 4.5 came out on top for overall quality and finish.

Results:
•  Grok 4.5: 9/10 — Delivered a genuinely polished, production-like game experience
•  Fable 5: 7.5/10
•  GPT 5.5: 7/10
The other two models produced results that felt rushed and incomplete, while Grok 4.5 stood out for cleaner execution, better structure, and overall refinement.
This wasn’t a traditional synthetic benchmark — it was a practical test focused on real developer output quality. Grok 4.5’s ability to generate more finished, higher-quality results in the same conditions highlights a meaningful strength beyond raw benchmark scores.

STARSHIP FLIGHT 13: WHAT TO EXPECT THIS WEEK

SpaceX is targeting Thursday, July 16 for Starship Flight 13 — the second flight of the upgraded V3 vehicle.

Here’s what we’re expecting on this test flight:
•  Second flight of the new V3 Starship and Super Heavy booster, incorporating upgrades and lessons from Flight 12
•  First test deployment of next-generation Starlink V3 satellites
•  Continued evaluation of the improved heat shield and reentry performance
•  Controlled splashdown of the upper stage in the Indian Ocean
•  Further testing of the new launch infrastructure at Starbase
This flight is primarily focused on validating the V3 design and building operational confidence. A booster catch attempt is not expected on Flight 13, but it remains a strong possibility for Flight 14 if this mission goes well.
Overall, Flight 13 is another step toward increasing launch cadence and proving out Starship’s reusability at scale. The long-term goal remains clear: dramatically lower the cost of getting mass to orbit

GROK BUILD SEES EXPLOSIVE GROWTH IN ITS FIRST FULL MONTH

Grok Build just wrapped its first complete month (June) with traffic surging 151.12% compared to its launch month in May.
That kind of growth in such a short time shows strong early adoption and real demand for the platform. 

Developers and users are clearly finding value in the tool as xAI continues to push forward with agentic coding and build capabilities.
Rapid early traction like this is a strong signal, especially in a competitive space where new AI tools launch frequently.
